what: Pre-check of the 4.4 handoff commands in Claude's Linux workspace. NOT Duy's machine and NOT Conda: it only shows that the bundle, pins and commands work in a fresh Python 3.11 venv. The 4.4 result still requires t44_handoff_check.ps1 on Duy's Windows PC with a new Conda env.

environment.kind: venv (python3.11 -m venv), packages from bundle requirements.txt
environment.note: nvidia-nccl-cu12 is a Linux-only dependency of the xgboost wheel; the Windows wheel does not pull it

windows_wheel_availability: numpy 2.4.6, xgboost 3.2.0 and scipy 1.17.1 wheels exist for Python 3.11 win_amd64 (pip download check)
driver_test: t44_handoff_check.ps1 was run end-to-end with PowerShell 7.4.6 on Linux against a stand-in conda (venv-based) in a folder path containing a space: PASS; wrong ZIP and missing conda both stop with FAIL as intended. Not yet run on Windows PowerShell 5.1 with real Conda.
